payload.title: Restore report action summary contract
payload.description:
Observed behavior: the stakeholder presentation omits the decision summary and action workstreams expected by the report UI.

Feature: Report action summary contract

Scenario: Present pending analysis actions
Given a portfolio report has an incomplete analysis state and repair findings
When the stakeholder presentation is built
Then it includes a decision summary with the analysis state
And it includes grouped action workstreams with safe next actions
And the dashboard can render the contract without a fallback.
